title: Femern Link Contractors
description:
Femern Link Contractors (FLC) is an international joint venture responsible for designing and building the Fehmarnbelt tunnel between Denmark and Germany. Its work includes the immersed tunnel, tunnel portals and ramps, and the factory that produces the tunnel elements.
During the attack, we bypassed EDR and infiltrated infrastructure. Since September 17, 2026, we have had full access to all confidential files of Femern Link Contractors, including internal correspondence, contracts, agreements, insurance documents, tunnel construction photos, site videos, procurement records, bank accounts and balances, employee personal data, and more.

After gaining access to all systems, we encrypted all vCenter virtual machines on the day of the attack, resulting in a complete infrastructure shutdown.

As a cybersecurity group, we do not wish to harm company and have sought a resolution. In an alternative outcome, this data and incident might never have been published (as with other clients with whom we successfully negotiated). However, due to interference from the Danish police, cooperation was prevented, and Femern Link Contractors will now suffer maximum reputational damage. All confidential construction information will become publicly available, including:

C1 - Strategy
C2 - QHSE
C3 - Risk Management
C4 - Compliance & Interface
C5 - Project Control
P1 - Works Preparation
P2 - Design & Engineering
P3 - Execution
P4 - Completion
S1 - Contract Management
S2 - Procurement
S3 - Human Resources
S4 - Admin & Finance
S5 - Communication & PR
S6 - Information Systems & Document Control
S7 - Industrial Relations
XX IT - Temporary
YY - PointCloud

In total, 1,576,452 files and 154,206 folders (2.44 TB) were exfiltrated.
The data is available for purchase either as individual files or as the entire dataset. | Status: selling | $500,000
